verses.text: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

segments.text: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

verses.text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

segments.text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

notes: 109.2 of the deceitful: Heb. of deceit
109.2 are opened: Heb. have opened themselves

verses.text: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

segments.text: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

verses.text: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

segments.text: For my love they are my adversaries: but I
give myself unto
prayer.

verses.text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

segments.text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

verses.text: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

segments.text: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

verses.text: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

segments.text: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

notes: 109.7 be condemned: Heb. go out guilty, or, wicked

verses.text: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

segments.text: Let his days be few;
and
let another take his office.

verses.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

segments.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.text: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

segments.text: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek
their bread
also out of their desolate places.

verses.text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

segments.text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

verses.text: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

segments.text: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

verses.text: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

segments.text: Let his posterity be cut off;
and
in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

segments.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.text: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

segments.text: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.text: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

segments.text: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

verses.text: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

segments.text: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

verses.text: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

segments.text: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

notes: 109.18 into his bowels: Heb. within him

verses.text: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

segments.text: Let it be unto him as the garment
which
covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

verses.text: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

segments.text: Let
this
be
the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

verses.text: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

segments.text: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy
is
good, deliver thou me.

verses.text: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

segments.text: For I
am
poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

segments.text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

verses.text: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

segments.text: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

verses.text: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

segments.text: I became also a reproach unto them:
when
they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

verses.text: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

segments.text: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

verses.text: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.

segments.text: That they may know that this
is
thy hand;
that
thou, LORD, hast done it.

verses.text: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

segments.text: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

verses.text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

segments.text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

verses.text: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

segments.text: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

verses.text: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

segments.text: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save
him
from those that condemn his soul.

headings.text: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
